test_cases.name: client-startup-bundle
test_cases.description: Start R2C client with credential bundle (10s timed test)
test_cases.expected: Heartbeat + connection logs, graceful exit after 10s

test_cases.name: client-startup-client-config
test_cases.description: Start R2C client with client config (no bundle)
test_cases.expected: Client starts and connects via Zenoh

test_cases.name: client-dry-run
test_cases.description: Start R2C client in dry_run mode (observations published, actions logged only)
test_cases.expected: Observations published to Zenoh; actions logged but not executed

test_cases.name: client-record-observations
test_cases.expected: Non-empty .pkl file created at specified path

test_cases.name: client-log-file
test_cases.description: Write logs to rotating log file

test_cases.name: client-custom-hardware-class
test_cases.description: Start client with custom hardware adapter class

test_cases.name: client-encrypted-key-prompt
test_cases.description: Encrypted private key triggers password prompt

test_cases.name: client-no-prompt-password
test_cases.expected: Error: Encrypted private key detected, but password prompting is disabled

test_cases.name: client-env-password
test_cases.description: Provide private key password via environment variable

test_cases.name: client-missing-bundle
test_cases.description: Missing bundle and project-id should fail
test_cases.expected: Error: project_id is required when --bundle is not provided

variables.bundle_path: Path to credential bundle zip (from robot export-certificate)
variables.encrypted_bundle: Path to credential bundle with encrypted private key
variables.robot_config: Path to robot config YAML (default: config/robot_dummy_config.yaml)
variables.dry_run_config: Path to robot config YAML with runtime.dry_run: true
variables.project_id: Project ID (required when not using bundle)
variables.device_id: Device ID (required when not using bundle)
variables.hardware_class: Dotted import path for custom IRobotHardwareAdapter
variables.password_env_var: Environment variable name holding private key password

notes: Client tests (type=write) are long-running; use --duration for timed tests
Client tests require BUNDLE_PATH (credential bundle from robot export-certificate)
Dry-run tests (TC-03) publish real observations but do not execute actions on hardware
TC-07/TC-08/TC-09 test encrypted private key password handling
TC-10 verifies error handling when required parameters are missing
For comprehensive end-to-end testing beyond these checks, run the commands from SKILL.md manually
